<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_transform_script"><sys_transform_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><name>Employee Import Validation</name><order>100</order><script>(function transformEntry(source, target, map, log, isUpdate) {

    // Trim incoming values
    if (source.u_employee_id)
        source.u_employee_id = source.u_employee_id.toString().trim().toUpperCase();

    if (source.u_employee_name)
        source.u_employee_name = source.u_employee_name.toString().trim();

    if (source.u_email)
        source.u_email = source.u_email.toString().trim().toLowerCase();

    if (source.u_department)
        source.u_department = source.u_department.toString().trim();

    if (source.u_location)
        source.u_location = source.u_location.toString().trim();

    // Required field validation
    if (!source.u_employee_id) {
        ignore = true;
        log.warn('Skipped employee row: Employee ID is empty.');
        return;
    }

    if (!source.u_employee_name) {
        ignore = true;
        log.warn('Skipped employee row: Employee Name is empty for ' +
                 source.u_employee_id);
        return;
    }

    // Basic email validation when an email is supplied
    if (source.u_email) {
        var emailPattern = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/;

        if (!emailPattern.test(source.u_email.toString())) {
            ignore = true;
            log.warn('Skipped employee row: Invalid email for ' +
                     source.u_employee_id);
        }
    }
